jobs.title: Operations Supervisor
jobs.description:
**avfleet.ai** is a FaaS company that operates large scale depots that manage EV and AV fleets. In the Operations Supervisor role, you will lead our Operations Coordinator team and their driver cohorts. You will own the schedule, and be accountable for driver KPIs. If you like solving staffing problems in real time and are passionate about supervising high performing teams then this job is for you.  

  

**What you’ll do*** Lead the coordinator team. Direct a team of Operations Coordinators who together supervise about 80 drivers — set priorities, resolve escalations, and hold the team accountable for their driver groups.
* Own the schedule. Build driver and Operations Coordinator shift schedules against forecasted volume, manage call\-outs, and keep overtime under control.
* Develop people. Coach drivers and coordinators, run performance conversations, handle corrective action and nurture a culture of ownership, collaboration and sense of urgency.
* Keep timekeeping clean. Review and approve driver and coordinator hours, confirm meal and rest periods are recorded correctly, and ensure strict compliance with California wage and hour laws.
* Run the daily numbers. Track attendance, driver KPIs, and exceptions, and propose action plans for improving performance. Own the outcome when things go sideways. Direct the response to on\-site incidents and vehicle events, figure out what changed, and make sure it gets reported and fixed.

  

**What you bring*** Two or more years supervising or leading an hourly workforce in delivery, logistics, transportation, warehouse, or field operations — or an equivalent combination of experience and training
* Experience building schedules and managing timekeeping for 20 or more hourly employees
* Comfort with scheduling, timekeeping, and dispatch software, and with spreadsheets
* Availability for early morning, evening, and weekend shifts on a rotating basis
* Clear communication — you can coach someone and document it.
* A valid driver’s license, and the ability to meet our vehicle insurability standards and the driving\-eligibility requirements of the delivery platforms we operate on. Operating our vehicles is an occasional part of this job, and no other form of transportation substitutes for moving a company van.

**We don’t require a degree for this role.**  

  

**Nice to have*** Prior experience driving on a rideshare or delivery platform such as Uber or Lyft.
* Experience with EV fleets, charging operations, or other fleet depot operations.
* Working knowledge of California labor laws pertaining to overtime and meal and rest breaks.
* Conversational ability in Spanish.

  

**The work environment**  

This is an on\-site role in an active vehicle yard. You’ll move between the office and the yard throughout the day, occasionally lift items up to 40 pounds, occasionally get in and out of vehicles, and work a schedule that includes early mornings, evenings, and weekends. If you need reasonable accommodation to perform any part of this job, we’ll work through it with you.  

  

**Compensation and benefits**  

Base salary: $72,050 – $75,000 per year. This is the good\-faith range we reasonably expect to pay for this position on hire. Where you land in the range depends on your experience, skills, and internal equity.  

We also offer medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, and California paid sick leave.  

  

**How to apply**  

Email your resume and the role you’re applying for to hiring@avfleet.ai  

We read every application — no automated screening, no resume\-ranking software. A person reviews your materials.  

  

Equal opportunity and legal notices  

**Avfleet.ai** is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy or related conditions, age (40 and over), physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

As a leader in the jewelry industry for four generations and as the largest family\-owned jeweler in the U.S., Shane Co. serves our customers with an unparalleled standard of excellence. Our people get to share in our customers’ milestone moments such as weddings, birthdays, anniversaries, and everything in between. We are looking for passionate, fun, vibrant individuals who want to be a part of our dynamic company culture in a retail environment.

  

Our goal for you is to give you employment experience like no other so you wake up and want to come to work every day! And as a member of the leadership team, we will count on you to give an amazing experience to both our customers and our team members! Felton’s Senior Division specializes in a full continuum of mental health services for older adults in outpatient clinics, the community, and supportive housing sites, as well as programs in employment training, economic security, case management, advocacy, and social connection and inclusion.

Federal lending reforms have created a significant market shift. Students who fill that gap with private loans will enter repayment looking to lower their rates. Borrowers need transparent, competitive options both in school and after graduation.

Intro chat with the hiring manager, a case study exercise, cross\-functional conversations with senior leadership, and references.

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. **Your role at a glance**

The Senior Business Operations Specialist is an advanced subject matter expert who serves as a liaison for the Investment Teams, Finance, Sourcing and Procurement, as well as the COO functions. The Senior Business Operations Specialist assesses budgets, identifies opportunities for improvement, and supports the development of efficient and cost\-effective operational solutions.

* Serves as the liaison between the Business and Finance to support investment management and the deployment of various investment vehicles (REIT, DEVCO, JVs at various percentage of ownership, GWT plans).
* Interprets business case scenarios and provides collected data on inputs.
* Assists with the implementation of new processes, policies and procedures within our business areas.
* Identify ways to improve stakeholder experiences.
* In collaboration with Finance, manage budget creation, monthly budget vs actuals, finance related questions.
* Tracks and reports on business operational and financial performance across business areas.
* Understands policy and procedures which drive business outcomes.
* Drives increased data quality and solve challenging business goals.
Perform any other related task as required.

* Ability to produce a high quality of work.

* Ability to multitask and work independently.

Frequently advises key people outside own area of expertise on complex matters, using persuasion in delivering messages.  
*

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business Administration or a related field.  

*

* Advanced professional experience in business operations management, including investment management, and a strong background across all aspects.
* 5\+ years of experience managing budgets and forecasts, year\-end accruals, project savings tracking, and vendor contracts.
* An understanding of Operations 3 *rd* party contracts, staffing models, and their respective costs.
* Professional experience dealing with internal and external stakeholders.
